text_block_list.text:
It's the first day of the year, and for
some
reason...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
"#NewYearsSunrise #SharingIsCaring

#NewYearSameCuteCurrenChan" 

...Hehe. It sure is beautiful...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
We're watching the first sunrise of the
year from a
mountain peak.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Take a pic for me! Hm... I think I'll
pretend I'm
holding up the sun. As for
you...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Take a pic for me! Hm... I think I'll
pretend I'm
holding up the sun. As for
you...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Happy New Year. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: I hope you'll spoil me lots this year too!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян
choice_data_list: Why are we on a mountain?!

text_block_list.text: I hope you'll spoil me lots this year too!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян
choice_data_list: Why are we on a mountain?!

text_block_list.text:
Because it's the perfect place to get a
great pic of
the year's first sunrise,
obviously!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I've already gotten some beauts, so I'd
say the
year's off to a great start! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Plus... I've gotten some energy from the
sun!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Yep! I need to make sure I'm charged
up!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
We're about to decide what path I
should take,
after all.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: I think... I really do want the Triple Tiara.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
But do I have what it takes? I guess we'll
find out
soon enough.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
The Fillies' Revue will be the race that
decides her
path, and it comes up right
after the New Year's
holiday. She seems
particularly motivated to take
on this
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I really wanna do whatever I can to win
it. After
all...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: A tiara would look great on me! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: That's it! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
She's picked a really tough path
considering her
motive, but I do want to
encourage her to pursue
her goals.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Welp! Now that the sun's up, it's time to
go back
down the mountain.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I'm free after this... Is there anything I
can do
today to help me get that tiara?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян
choice_data_list:
You need to get your speed up as much as
possible!

You should get some rest and enjoy the
holidays.
You need to shine every way you can.

text_block_list.text:
Awww, you make it sound so easy! Is
that really
all I need to do?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
If there's anything that can get her the
win, it's
her speed. I tell her she should
hone the skills she
has.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hone my skills, huh?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Okay, got it! I'll be faster than
anyone! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I've got an idea! Race me down the
mountain!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Yep! Let's see who can get to the
bottom of the
mountain faster!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Yep! Let's see who can get to the
bottom of the
mountain faster!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
With you chasing me, I'll be super
motivated!
Smart, right? ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
With you chasing me, I'll be super
motivated!
Smart, right? ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Just make sure you don't get hurt. I'll
think about
the conditions for winning or
losing while we're
running!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
There's no way I could ever win against
Curren
Chan. She's an Umamusume!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ready, set, go!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Catch up, slowpoke! Oh! Watch your
step here!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Catch up, slowpoke! Oh! Watch your
step here!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I guess there's no need to rush
things
during the break.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Sooo, what are you gonna do after this?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян
choice_data_list: Probably head back to the academy.

text_block_list.text: ...What about me?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян
choice_data_list: You can do whatever you want.

text_block_list.text:
Hm... Then I guess I'm completely free.
Hmmm...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян stares at me as if she's
trying to hint
at something.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Buuut I guess there aren't many places
open on
New Year's Day.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Oh, actually, I think I saw a little cafe
that was
open on the way up. Maybe I'll
go check it out!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
It'd be kinda weird to go alone, though.
And it
sure would be nice to chat about
the hike with the
person I went hiking
with...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян
choice_data_list: ...Is is okay if I tag along?

text_block_list.text: Oh! Of course! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I've actually been wanting to go for a
while, but I
never had an excuse to make
the trek up before.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I think we should be able to take it easy
there.
What do you say?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I think we should be able to take it easy
there.
What do you say?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: ...Oh, okay!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
So basically, you just want me to shine
more?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
So basically, you just want me to shine
more?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Then we'll have to go on a bunch of
dates until I
figure out how! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Well, what do you expect?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I mean, who says things like "I want you
to shine"
these days? Not even the
cheesiest rom-coms are
dropping lines
like that.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
But if you want me to shine, you're
gonna need to
keep me excited.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
So make sure those dates are exciting,
'kay?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
So make sure those dates are exciting,
'kay?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Well... at the very least, it seems Curren
Chan has
found a hint on how to make
herself shine even
more.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As expected, it's not any kind of
competition...
and I end up buying us ice
cream at the base of
the mountain as a
penalty for losing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We sit and rest until Каррен Тян's
satisfied.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
